children: MEDICLINIC MIDDLE EAST ANNOUNCES AED 420 MILLION INVESTMENT TO EXPAND MEDICLINIC PARKVIEW HOSPITAL IN DUBAI - GDMO
MEDICLINIC PARKVIEW HOSPITAL EXPANSION WILL STRENGTHEN THE HOSPITAL'S CAPABILITIES ACROSS A RANGE OF SPECIALISED AND ADVANCED MEDICAL SERVICES - GDMO
EXPANSION ALSO INCLUDES ENHANCED PAEDIATRIC SERVICES, INCLUDING ESTABLISHMENT OF A DEDICATED PAEDIATRIC URGENT CARE UNIT  - GDMO
EXPANSION WILL ALSO DEVELOP THE HOSPITAL'S DIGITAL AND OPERATIONAL CAPABILITIES THROUGH THE DEPLOYMENT OF AUTOMATION AND SMART TECHNOLOGIES - GDMO
CONSTRUCTION ON PROJECT IS EXPECTED TO BEGIN SHORTLY, WITH THE EXPANSION SCHEDULED FOR COMPLETION DURING 2027 - GDMO
